title: Dashboard loads summary cards and charts successfully
description: Verifies that the dashboard shows a loading state, then renders summary cards (income, expenses, balance) and charts.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Login" button
Verify element "loading indicator for summary" is visible
Verify element "summary cards for income, expenses, and balance" is visible

title: Dashboard charts are visible after summary loads
description: Verifies that charts are displayed on the dashboard once the summary has finished loading.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Login" button
Wait for element "summary cards for income, expenses, and balance" to appear

title: Balance section is visible on the dashboard
description: Verifies that the current balance information is visible on the dashboard summary cards.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Login" button
Wait for element "summary cards for income, expenses, and balance" to appear

title: Add a new transaction successfully from Transactions page
description: Verifies a user can add a valid transaction and see it appear in the transaction list.

steps.description: Click on "Transactions" in the main navigation

title: Validate amount field error, then successfully submit after correction
description: Verifies invalid amount entry shows validation error and corrected amount allows successful submission.

steps.description: Click on "Transactions" in the main navigation

title: Edit an existing transaction and see the updated value in the list
description: Verifies a user can open a transaction, edit a field, save, and see the updated information reflected in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Transactions" in the main navigation
Click on a transaction item in the list
Type "Updated description" into the description field

title: Transaction list loads and is viewable
description: Verifies the transactions page loads and the transaction list section is visible to the user.

steps.description: Click on "Transactions" in the main navigation

title: Delete a transaction and handle failure toast message
description: Verifies that when deletion fails, the UI shows an error toast message and the user remains on the transactions page.

steps.description: Click on "Transactions" in the main navigation
Verify text "Could not delete transaction" is visible

title: Add a new loan and see it in the loans list
description: Verifies a user can add a new loan and the newly created loan appears in the loan list.

steps.description: Click on "Loans" in the main navigation
Type "Alex QA" into the Borrower/Lender field
Type "E2E test loan" into the Notes field

title: Mark an active loan as paid and verify status updates in the list
description: Verifies a user can mark an active loan as paid and see the loan status reflect the change in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Loans" in the main navigation
Click "Mark as paid" on an active loan

title: Cancel marking a loan as paid leaves the loan unchanged
description: Verifies a user can cancel the confirmation dialog and the loan remains active/unpaid.

steps.description: Click on "Loans" in the main navigation
Click "Mark as paid" on an active loan

title: Attempt to add a loan with missing required fields shows a validation message
description: Verifies the loan form prevents saving when required fields are missing and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Loans" in the main navigation

title: Attempt to add a loan with a non-numeric amount shows a validation message
description: Verifies the loan form rejects a non-numeric amount and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Loans" in the main navigation
Type "Jamie QA" into the Borrower/Lender field
Type "one hundred" into the Amount field

title: Paid loans do not offer a Mark as paid action
description: Verifies a loan already marked as paid does not present the "Mark as paid" action in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Loans" in the main navigation
Scroll to a loan row that shows status "Paid"
Verify text "Mark as paid" is not visible

title: Generate reports for a valid date range and view populated charts/tables
description: Verifies that a user can generate a report for a valid date range and see charts/tables populated.

steps.description: Click on the "Reports" navigation link/menu item
Select a valid start date in the report start date field
Select a valid end date (after the start date) in the report end date field

title: Date range validation: start date after end date shows error
description: Verifies that generating a report with an invalid date range shows an 'Invalid date range' validation error.

steps.description: Click on the "Reports" navigation link/menu item
Select an end date in the report end date field
Select a start date that is after the selected end date in the report start date field
Verify text "Invalid date range" is visible

title: Fix invalid date range and successfully generate report
description: Verifies that after seeing the invalid date range error, the user can correct dates and generate the report successfully.

steps.description: Click on the "Reports" navigation link/menu item
Select an end date in the report end date field
Select a start date that is after the selected end date in the report start date field
Verify text "Invalid date range" is visible
Select a new start date that is before the selected end date in the report start date field

title: Generate report with same start and end date (single-day report)
description: Verifies that generating a report for a single day (start date equals end date) works and shows report output.

steps.description: Click on the "Reports" navigation link/menu item
Select a date in the report start date field
Select the same date in the report end date field

title: Required fields validation: attempt to generate with missing dates
description: Verifies that the page prevents report generation when required date fields are missing and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on the "Reports" navigation link/menu item

title: Export action is available after generating a report (visibility check)
description: Verifies that after generating a report, an Export control is visible to the user.

steps.description: Click on the "Reports" navigation link/menu item
Select a valid start date in the report start date field
Select a valid end date (after the start date) in the report end date field

title: OCR receipt upload populates results and saves as a new transaction
description: Verifies a user can upload a receipt, see OCR results populated, and save them as a transaction that appears in the Transactions list.

steps.description: Click on the "Receipt Scanner" or "Scan" navigation item

title: Save OCR results as transaction and verify it appears in Transactions list
description: Verifies that after OCR results appear, saving creates a transaction and it is visible in the Transactions page list.

steps.description: Click on the "Receipt Scanner" or "Scan" navigation item
Verify text "Save as Transaction" is visible

title: After saving from OCR, navigate to Transactions and confirm a new entry is visible
description: Verifies that the user can open Transactions after saving and see a new transaction row added (using visible list change/confirmation).

title: Retry OCR from error state keeps user on Scan page and shows status updates
description: Verifies the Retry OCR button can be clicked from the error state and the user sees a processing/uploading indication.

steps.description: Click on the "Receipt Scanner" or "Scan" navigation item

title: Repeated OCR failure shows manual-entry suggestion and routes user to Transactions
description: Verifies that when OCR continues to fail, the UI suggests manual entry and provides a working path to Transactions.

steps.description: Click on the "Receipt Scanner" or "Scan" navigation item
Verify text "Enter transaction manually" is visible
Click the button or link that opens Transactions for manual entry

title: Manual-entry redirect lands on Transactions page from Scan OCR failure state
description: Verifies the manual-entry CTA from the OCR failure state opens the Transactions route successfully.

title: Create a new financial goal and verify it appears in the list with initial progress
description: Verifies a user can create a goal from Mimpi Kita and sees it listed with 0% (or equivalent initial) progress.

steps.description: Click on the "Mimpi Kita" navigation link/menu item
Type "Emergency Fund" into the goal name field
Type "5000000" into the target amount field
Type "2030-12-31" into the target date field

title: Create a goal and verify initial progress shows as 0% (or equivalent)
description: Verifies that after creating a goal, the UI indicates no contributions yet (0% progress or 0 contributed).

steps.description: Click on the "Mimpi Kita" navigation link/menu item
Type "New Laptop" into the goal name field
Type "15000000" into the target amount field
Type "2029-06-30" into the target date field

title: Validation: Attempt to create a goal with all required fields empty
description: Verifies required-field validation messages appear when saving a new goal without providing mandatory inputs.

steps.description: Click on the "Mimpi Kita" navigation link/menu item

title: Validation: Create goal missing target amount shows an error and does not create the goal
description: Verifies missing target amount triggers validation and prevents the goal from being added to the list.

steps.description: Click on the "Mimpi Kita" navigation link/menu item
Type "Trip Fund" into the goal name field
Type "2028-10-10" into the target date field

title: Create a new holiday plan with valid details
description: Verifies a user can create a holiday plan and see it listed with a budget summary.

steps.description: Click "Holiday" in the main navigation menu
Type "Bali Trip" into the trip name field
Type "2026-06-01" into the start date field
Type "2026-06-10" into the end date field

title: Validate budget must be positive when creating a holiday plan
description: Verifies creating a holiday plan with a negative budget shows a validation error and does not create the plan.

steps.description: Click "Holiday" in the main navigation menu
Type "Negative Budget Test" into the trip name field
Verify text "Budget must be positive" is visible
Verify text "Negative Budget Test" is not visible

title: Cancel creating a holiday plan without saving
description: Verifies the user can exit the create holiday plan flow without creating a new plan.

steps.description: Click "Holiday" in the main navigation menu
Type "Should Not Save" into the trip name field
Verify text "Should Not Save" is not visible

title: Required field validation when creating a holiday plan with missing trip name
description: Verifies the create plan form shows a validation message when required fields are missing.

steps.description: Click "Holiday" in the main navigation menu

title: Add a new asset and see it reflected in the asset list and net worth
description: Verifies a user can add an asset from the Wealth page and that the asset appears in the list with net worth updated.

steps.description: Click on "Wealth" in the main navigation

title: Open Add Asset form from Wealth page
description: Verifies the Add Asset entry point is present and opens the asset creation form.

steps.description: Click on "Wealth" in the main navigation

title: Save a valid asset entry
description: Verifies completing the Add Asset form with valid values saves successfully and shows the new asset in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Wealth" in the main navigation
Type "QA Asset - Gold" into the asset name field
Type "2500000" into the current value field

title: Complete asset creation by selecting a category and saving
description: Verifies selecting a category and saving creates the asset and updates visible net worth text/value.

steps.description: Click on "Wealth" in the main navigation

title: Validation error when entering non-numeric value for asset current value
description: Verifies the form blocks saving when the value field is non-numeric and shows the specified validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Wealth" in the main navigation
Type "QA Asset - Invalid Value" into the asset name field
Type "abc" into the current value field

title: Show validation message after attempting to save with invalid numeric input
description: Verifies clicking Save with an invalid value displays the exact error text 'Enter a numeric value'.

steps.description: Click on "Wealth" in the main navigation
Type "abc" into the current value field
Verify text "Enter a numeric value" is visible

title: Correct invalid value and successfully save asset
description: Verifies a user can fix the invalid value and save, resulting in the asset appearing in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Wealth" in the main navigation
Type "QA Asset - Corrected" into the asset name field
Type "99999" into the current value field

title: Finish corrected save and verify asset is listed
description: Verifies saving after correction completes without validation errors and the asset is visible on the Wealth page.

steps.description: Click on "Wealth" in the main navigation
Type "100000" into the current value field
Verify text "Enter a numeric value" is not visible

title: Security: Verify file upload restrictions (MIME Type)
description: Ensures that only safe file types (jpg, jpeg, png, pdf) are allowed in the receipt scanner.

steps.description: Pick a non-image file (e.g., test.txt) to upload
Verify error message contains "invalid file type" or "must be an image/pdf"
Pick a valid image file (e.g., receipt.jpg) to upload
Verify upload proceeds successfully without type error

title: Branding: Verify 'Dompet Kita' consistency
description: Ensures the application name is correctly displayed as 'Dompet Kita' and not as a variable like ${APP_NAME}.

steps.description: Verify documentation title or meta name is "Dompet Kita"
Verify text "Dompet Kita" is present in the sidebar or header
Verify text "${APP_NAME}" is NOT present anywhere on the page
